files.spec/prototypes/P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER.yaml:
id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER
type: prototype
title: Base Tabs Trigger is a value-matched tab activation item
status: draft
since: 0.1.0
summary: Base Tabs Trigger is the repeatable tab item part that provides a protocol value, derives selected state from Tabs context, participates in the list collection and roving focus, and requests root selection through activation.
statement:
  zh-CN: >-
    Base Tabs Trigger 是 Base Tabs anatomy family 中可重复的 trigger part。Trigger 必须提供用于 Tabs selection matching 的 protocol `value`，消费 Tabs context，并在自身 value 与 context selected value 相等时派生 selected state。Enabled trigger 在成功 activation 后向 root 请求 selection；automatic activation mode 下，trigger 获得 focus 也可以请求 selection。Trigger 可以暴露局部 `click` signal 供 App Maker 观察 trigger activation，但 Tabs selected value 的 outward signal 属于 root `valueChange`。


  en: >-
    Base Tabs Trigger is the repeatable trigger part in the Base Tabs anatomy family. Trigger must provide a protocol `value` used for Tabs selection matching, consume Tabs context, and derive selected state when its own value equals the context selected value. An enabled trigger requests root selection after successful activation; in automatic activation mode, focus may also request selection. Trigger may expose a local `click` signal for App Maker observation of trigger activation, but the outward signal for Tabs selected value belongs to root `valueChange`.


criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-ROLE-TAB
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 是 tab activation item，不是 selected value owner 或 tabpanel content owner。
      en: Tabs Trigger is a tab activation item, not the selected value owner or tabpanel content owner.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-tabs-trigger` direct prototype 与 `asTabsTrigger` authored asHook 是同一 Tabs trigger protocol 的两个 authoring entries。'
      en: 'The `base-tabs-trigger` direct prototype and the `asTabsTrigger` authored asHook are two authoring entries of the same Tabs trigger protocol.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CORE-SYNTAX-0003
        - C-AS-HOOK-0001
      decisions:
        - D-PROTOTYPE-ENTITY-NAMING-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-PROTOCOL-DEPENDENCY
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 的语义成立依赖 `P-BASE-TABS` 定义的 Tabs anatomy family 与 Tabs context；它不得脱离 Tabs root 自行定义 tab selection 语义。
      en: Tabs Trigger semantics depend on the Tabs anatomy family and Tabs context defined by `P-BASE-TABS`; it must not define tab selection semantics independently from Tabs root.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-NO-BUTTON-DEPENDENCY
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 不应通过消费 Button protocol 获得 tab 语义；它可以参考 Button 的 activation、focus、disabled 与 press lifecycle 准则。
      en: Tabs Trigger should not obtain tab semantics by consuming the Button protocol; it may reference Button activation, focus, disabled, and press lifecycle criteria.
    dependsOn:
      decisions:
        - D-BASE-PROTOTYPE-INDEPENDENCE-0001
    references:
      prototypes:
        - id: P-BASE-BUTTON
          anchors:
            - P-BASE-BUTTON-TRIGGER-SEMANTICS
            - P-BASE-BUTTON-PRESS-LIFECYCLE
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-CLAIM-ROLE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须 claim `base-tabs` anatomy family 的 `trigger` role。
      en: Tabs Trigger must claim the `trigger` role in the `base-tabs` anatomy family.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0004
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-SAME-DOMAIN
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须解析到同一 Tabs domain 中的 Tabs root 与 list；跨 Tabs domain 的 context 或 collection 不得被消费。
      en: Tabs Trigger must resolve to the Tabs root and list in the same Tabs domain; context or collection from another Tabs domain must not be consumed.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
        - C-CONTEXT-0002
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-PROP-VALUE
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Tabs Trigger 必须接受 `value?: string` props input；可靠参与 Tabs selection matching 需要提供有效 value。'
      en: 'Tabs Trigger must accept a `value?: string` props input; reliably participating in Tabs selection matching requires a valid value.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-PROPS-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-PROP-DISABLED
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Tabs Trigger 必须接受 `disabled?: boolean` props input，默认值为 `false`。'
      en: 'Tabs Trigger must accept a `disabled?: boolean` props input whose default is `false`.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-PROPS-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-CONTEXT-CONSUME
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须读取或订阅 Tabs context，以获得 selected value、activeValue、orientation、activationMode 与 controlled 状态。
      en: Tabs Trigger must read or subscribe to Tabs context to obtain selected value, activeValue, orientation, activationMode, and controlled state.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CONTEXT-0006
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-SELECTED-DERIVED
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 的 `selected` state 必须由自身 protocol value 与 Tabs context selected value 的相等关系派生。
      en: Tabs Trigger `selected` state must be derived from equality between its own protocol value and Tabs context selected value.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-STATE-0001
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-SELECTED-EXPOSE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须 expose `selected` state；`selected=true` 表示该 trigger 对应当前 selected Tabs value。
      en: Tabs Trigger must expose `selected` state; `selected=true` means the trigger corresponds to the current selected Tabs value.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-EXPOSE-STATE-0001
        - C-STATE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-NO-ACTIVE-EXPOSE-FIRST-PASS
    text:
      zh-CN: 第一轮 Tabs Trigger 不要求 expose `active` state；roving-focus active item 语义保留在 Tabs context `activeValue` 中，以避免与 Toggle active state 混淆。
      en: The first Tabs Trigger pass does not require exposing an `active` state; roving-focus active item semantics remain in Tabs context `activeValue` to avoid conflating with Toggle active state.
    references:
      prototypes:
        - id: P-BASE-TOGGLE
          anchors:
            - P-BASE-TOGGLE-ACTIVE-SCOPED-NAME
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-DISABLED-EXPOSE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须 expose `disabled` state。
      en: Tabs Trigger must expose `disabled` state.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-EXPOSE-STATE-0001
        - C-STATE-INTERACTION-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-INTERACTION-STATES
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 应 expose `hovered`、`focused`、`focusVisible` 与 `pressed` transient interaction states。
      en: Tabs Trigger should expose transient interaction states `hovered`, `focused`, `focusVisible`, and `pressed`.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-STATE-INTERACTION-0001
        - C-EXPOSE-STATE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-FOCUSABLE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须作为可聚焦 tab item，并支持 `focusSelf`。
      en: Tabs Trigger must act as a focusable tab item and support `focusSelf`.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-AS-FOCUSABLE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-COLLECTION-ITEM
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须注册为 Tabs trigger collection item，collection meta 至少包含 value 与 disabled。
      en: Tabs Trigger must register as a Tabs trigger collection item whose collection metadata includes at least value and disabled.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
        - C-AS-FOCUS-ROVING-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-ACTIVATION-REQUESTS-SELECTION
    text:
      zh-CN: Enabled Tabs Trigger 在成功 activation 后必须以自身 value 请求 root selection。
      en: An enabled Tabs Trigger must request root selection with its own value after successful activation.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-AS-TRIGGER-0001
        - C-EVENT-TYPE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-KEYBOARD-ACTIVATION
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须通过 Trigger semantics 支持键盘 activation；focused trigger 的 Space keydown 必须阻止页面滚动等宿主默认动作。
      en: Tabs Trigger must support keyboard activation through Trigger semantics; Space keydown on a focused trigger must prevent host default actions such as page scrolling.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-AS-TRIGGER-0001
        - C-EVENT-TYPE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-DISABLED-SUPPRESS-ACTIVATION
    text:
      zh-CN: Disabled Tabs Trigger 不得请求 root selection，也不得更新 Tabs context activeValue。
      en: A disabled Tabs Trigger must not request root selection or update Tabs context activeValue.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-STATE-INTERACTION-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-AUTOMATIC-FOCUS-SELECTION
    text:
      zh-CN: 在 `activationMode="automatic"` 时，enabled trigger 获得 focus 可以请求 root selection。
      en: When `activationMode="automatic"`, an enabled trigger may request root selection when it receives focus.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
      contracts:
        - C-AS-FOCUSABLE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-MANUAL-FOCUS-STABLE
    text:
      zh-CN: 在 `activationMode="manual"` 时，roving focus 移动不得自行改变 root selected value；selection 需要 activation 提交。
      en: When `activationMode="manual"`, roving focus movement must not by itself change root selected value; selection requires activation commit.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-CLICK-SIGNAL
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 可以 expose `click` event 作为局部 activation observation signal；该 signal 不得替代 root `valueChange` 作为 selection outward signal。
      en: Tabs Trigger may expose a `click` event as a local activation observation signal; that signal must not replace root `valueChange` as the selection outward signal.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-EXPOSE-EVENT-0001
    references:
      prototypes:
        - id: P-BASE-TABS
          anchors:
            - P-BASE-TABS-VALUE-CHANGE-SIGNAL
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-A11Y-ROLE
    text:
      zh-CN: 在具备 accessibility projection 的宿主中，Tabs Trigger 必须投射 tab 语义。
      en: In hosts with accessibility projection, Tabs Trigger must project tab semantics.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-A11Y-SELECTED
    text:
      zh-CN: 在具备 accessibility projection 的宿主中，Tabs Trigger 必须投射 selected state；Web 宿主应将 selected/未 selected 投射为 `aria-selected` true/false。
      en: In hosts with accessibility projection, Tabs Trigger must project selected state; Web hosts should project selected/not selected to `aria-selected` true/false.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-A11Y-DISABLED
    text:
      zh-CN: 在具备 accessibility projection 的宿主中，disabled Tabs Trigger 必须投射 disabled 语义。
      en: In hosts with accessibility projection, disabled Tabs Trigger must project disabled semantics.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-A11Y-CONTROLS-TARGET
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须声明它 controls 具有相同 protocol value 的 Tabs Content；Web 宿主应将该关系投射为 `aria-controls`。
      en: Tabs Trigger must declare that it controls the Tabs Content with the same protocol value; Web hosts should project that relationship as `aria-controls`.
    dependsOn:
      decisions:
        - D-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-PROJECTION-0001
      contracts:
        - id: C-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-0001
          since: 0.3.0-alpha.1
    note:
      zh-CN: controls 使用 C-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-0001 的同 domain、content role 与精确 value key；不在原型中拼接或保存目标宿主 ID。
      en: controls uses the same domain, content role and exact value key governed by C-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-0001; the prototype neither constructs nor stores a target host ID.
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-TRIGGER-ACCESSIBLE-NAME
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Trigger 必须允许从内容或宿主 projection 获得 accessible name。
      en: Tabs Trigger must allow an accessible name from content or host projection.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001

id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT
type: prototype
title: Base Tabs Content is a value-matched tabpanel part
status: draft
since: 0.1.0
summary: Base Tabs Content is a value-matched tabpanel whose view is lazy and detached while inactive by default, with keepMounted as the explicit retention policy.
statement:
  zh-CN: >-
    Base Tabs Content 是 Base Tabs anatomy family 中可重复的 content/tabpanel part。Content 通过 protocol `value` 消费 Tabs context 并派生 current state。默认只物化 current content 的 view，非 current content 执行 L1 detach 但保留 Proto instance；`keepMounted=true` 可显式保留完整 view。`base-tabs-content` direct prototype 与 `asTabsContent` authored asHook 是同一 protocol 的两个 authoring entries。


  en: >-
    Base Tabs Content is the repeatable content/tabpanel part in the Base Tabs anatomy family. Content consumes Tabs context through its protocol `value` and derives current state. By default only the current content view is materialized; inactive content performs an L1 detach while retaining its Proto instance. `keepMounted=true` explicitly retains the complete view. The direct prototype and `asTabsContent` are two authoring entries of the same protocol.


criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-ROLE-PANEL
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 是 selected value 对应的 tabpanel content part，不拥有 selected value 或 activation 语义。
      en: Tabs Content is the tabpanel content part corresponding to selected value and does not own selected value or activation semantics.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-tabs-content` direct prototype 与 `asTabsContent` authored asHook 是同一 Tabs content protocol 的两个 authoring entries。'
      en: 'The `base-tabs-content` direct prototype and the `asTabsContent` authored asHook are two authoring entries of the same Tabs content protocol.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CORE-SYNTAX-0003
        - C-AS-HOOK-0001
      decisions:
        - D-PROTOTYPE-ENTITY-NAMING-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-PROTOCOL-DEPENDENCY
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 的语义成立依赖 `P-BASE-TABS` 定义的 Tabs anatomy family 与 Tabs context；它不得脱离 Tabs root 自行定义 current panel 语义。
      en: Tabs Content semantics depend on the Tabs anatomy family and Tabs context defined by `P-BASE-TABS`; it must not define current panel semantics independently from Tabs root.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-CLAIM-ROLE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 必须 claim `base-tabs` anatomy family 的 `content` role。
      en: Tabs Content must claim the `content` role in the `base-tabs` anatomy family.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0004
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-SAME-DOMAIN
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 必须解析到同一 Tabs domain 中的 Tabs root；跨 Tabs domain 的 context 不得被消费。
      en: Tabs Content must resolve to the Tabs root in the same Tabs domain; context from another Tabs domain must not be consumed.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
        - C-CONTEXT-0002
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-PROP-VALUE
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Tabs Content 必须接受 `value?: string` props input；可靠参与 Tabs selection matching 需要提供有效 value。'
      en: 'Tabs Content must accept a `value?: string` props input; reliably participating in Tabs selection matching requires a valid value.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-PROPS-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-CONTEXT-CONSUME
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 必须读取或订阅 Tabs context，以获得 selected value。
      en: Tabs Content must read or subscribe to Tabs context to obtain selected value.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CONTEXT-0006
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-CURRENT-DERIVED
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 的 `current` state 必须由自身 protocol value 与 Tabs context selected value 的相等关系派生。
      en: Tabs Content `current` state must be derived from equality between its own protocol value and Tabs context selected value.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-STATE-0001
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-CURRENT-EXPOSE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 必须 expose `current` state；`current=true` 表示该 content 对应当前 selected Tabs value。
      en: Tabs Content must expose `current` state; `current=true` means the content corresponds to the current selected Tabs value.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-EXPOSE-STATE-0001
        - C-STATE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-HIDDEN-WHEN-INACTIVE
    text:
      zh-CN: 非 current Tabs Content 必须隐藏；具体 hidden 机制由宿主能力或 prototype implementation 投射，契约不绑定 CSS。
      en: Non-current Tabs Content must be hidden; the concrete hidden mechanism is projected by host capabilities or prototype implementation, and the contract is not bound to CSS.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-DEFAULT-L1-DETACH
    text:
      zh-CN: 非 current Tabs Content 默认不得物化 view；从 current 离开时必须执行 L1 detach，同时保留 Proto instance、状态与 exposes。
      en: Non-current Tabs Content must not materialize a view by default; leaving current must perform an L1 detach while preserving the Proto instance, state, and exposes.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-LIFECYCLE-0008
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-PRESENCE-POLICY
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Tabs Content 必须只以 `keepMounted?: boolean` 暴露 view retention 策略；默认 false，true 时 inactive content 保留完整 view 并投射 hidden 状态。'
      en: 'Tabs Content must expose view retention only through `keepMounted?: boolean`; it defaults to false, while true retains the complete inactive view and projects its hidden state.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-LIFECYCLE-0008
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-A11Y-ROLE
    text:
      zh-CN: 在具备 accessibility projection 的宿主中，Tabs Content 必须投射 tabpanel 语义。
      en: In hosts with accessibility projection, Tabs Content must project tabpanel semantics.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-A11Y-LABELLEDBY-TARGET
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Content 必须声明它被具有相同 protocol value 的 Tabs Trigger label；Web 宿主应将该关系投射为 `aria-labelledby`。
      en: Tabs Content must declare that it is labelled by the Tabs Trigger with the same protocol value; Web hosts should project that relationship as `aria-labelledby`.
    dependsOn:
      decisions:
        - D-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-PROJECTION-0001
      contracts:
        - id: C-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-0001
          since: 0.3.0-alpha.1
    note:
      zh-CN: labelledBy 使用 C-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-0001 的同 domain、trigger role 与精确 value key；两端 L1 detach 都撤销本 lease 的关系，恢复时沿用有效 identity reservation。
      en: labelledBy uses the same domain, trigger role and exact value key governed by C-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-0001; either endpoint L1 detach withdraws this lease and rematerialization reuses the valid identity reservation.
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-A11Y-HIDDEN
    text:
      zh-CN: 在具备 accessibility projection 的宿主中，非 current Tabs Content 的 hidden 状态必须被投射到 accessibility semantic tree。
      en: In hosts with accessibility projection, hidden state for non-current Tabs Content must be projected to the accessibility semantic tree.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-A11Y-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-TABINDEX-DEFERRED
    text:
      zh-CN: 已废弃的第一轮断口：tabpanel 是否自动进入 Tab 顺序不再暂缓；由 `P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-FOCUS-ENTRY` 接管。
      en: 'Deprecated first-pass gap: whether tabpanel automatically enters the Tab sequence is no longer deferred; `P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-FOCUS-ENTRY` now owns this requirement.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-AS-FOCUSABLE-0001
    status: deprecated
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-CONTENT-FOCUS-ENTRY
    text:
      zh-CN: Current Tabs Content 必须声明 focus entry region，并采用 descendant-first 与 fallback self 策略；inactive Content 必须禁用该 entry。
      en: Current Tabs Content must declare a focus entry region using descendant-first with fallback self policy; inactive Content must disable that entry.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-AS-FOCUS-ENTRY-0001
      decisions:
        - D-FOCUS-ENTRY-DELEGATION-0001
    note:
      zh-CN: 该准则表达跨宿主行为，不绑定 Web `tabIndex`、CSS 或具体 DOM 查询实现。
      en: This criterion expresses cross-host behavior and is not bound to Web `tabIndex`, CSS, or a concrete DOM query implementation.

  - path: spec/prototypes/P-BASE-TABS.yaml
  - path: packages/prototypes/base/src/tabs/content.proto.ts
  - path: packages/prototypes/base/src/tabs/types.ts
  - path: packages/prototypes/base/test/tabs.test.ts
  - path: https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/tabs/
    label: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices Guide - Tabs Pattern
dependsOn:
  prototypes:
    - P-BASE-TABS
  contracts:
    - C-ANATOMY-0004
    - C-CONTEXT-0006
    - C-STATE-0001
    - C-A11Y-0001
    - C-AS-FOCUS-ENTRY-0001
  decisions:
    - D-A11Y-PART-RELATIONSHIP-PROJECTION-0001
    - D-FOCUS-ENTRY-DELEGATION-0001
verifies:
  tests:
    - T-BASE-TABS-0001
revisions:
  - version: 0.3.0-alpha.1
    change: revised
    summary: Migrated reciprocal Tabs accessibility relationships to the exact-key same-domain service without changing selection, Context or focus ownership.
  - version: 0.1.0
    change: introduced
    summary: Added the first Base Tabs Content protocol catalog.
  - version: 0.1.1
    change: refined
    summary: Replaced deferred tabpanel focus entry gap with descendant-first focus entry requirement.

    summary: Added lazyMount, unmountOnExit, and keepMounted view policies on the repeatable lifecycle model.

files.spec/prototypes/P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR.ya:
id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR
type: prototype
title: Base Tabs Indicator is a context-driven tabs indicator
status: draft
since: 0.1.0
summary: Base Tabs Indicator is the optional and repeatable indicator part of Base Tabs. It consumes Tabs context for selected value, active value, orientation, and activation mode, but does not own selection, activation, focus, accessibility control, layout measurement, or event semantics.
statement:
  zh-CN: >-
    Base Tabs Indicator 是 Base Tabs anatomy family 中可选且可重复的 indicator part。它通过 Tabs context 消费 selected value、activeValue、orientation 与 activationMode，将这些信息作为视觉展示依据；它不拥有 selected value，不处理 activation，不参与 roving focus，不作为 event target，也不承诺读取 trigger/content 的真实布局尺寸或自动定位。`base-tabs-indicator` direct prototype 与 `asTabsIndicator` authored asHook 是同一 Tabs indicator protocol 的两个 authoring entries。


  en: >-
    Base Tabs Indicator is the optional and repeatable indicator part in the Base Tabs anatomy family. It consumes selected value, activeValue, orientation, and activationMode through Tabs context and uses them as visual display inputs; it does not own selected value, process activation, participate in roving focus, act as an event target, or promise real trigger/content layout measurement or automatic positioning. The `base-tabs-indicator` direct prototype and the `asTabsIndicator` authored asHook are two authoring entries of the same Tabs indicator protocol.


criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-ROLE-INDICATOR
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 只能作为 Tabs context 的 visual indicator；它不是 tab、tabpanel、input control、value owner 或 command control。
      en: Tabs Indicator may only be a visual indicator for Tabs context; it is not a tab, tabpanel, input control, value owner, or command control.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-tabs-indicator` direct prototype 与 `asTabsIndicator` authored asHook 是同一 Tabs indicator protocol 的两个 authoring entries。'
      en: 'The `base-tabs-indicator` direct prototype and the `asTabsIndicator` authored asHook are two authoring entries of the same Tabs indicator protocol.'
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CORE-SYNTAX-0003
        - C-AS-HOOK-0001
      decisions:
        - D-PROTOTYPE-ENTITY-NAMING-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-PROTOCOL-DEPENDENCY
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 的语义成立依赖 `P-BASE-TABS` 定义的 Tabs anatomy family 与 Tabs context；它不得脱离 Tabs root 自行定义 tabs 语义。
      en: Tabs Indicator semantics depend on the Tabs anatomy family and Tabs context defined by `P-BASE-TABS`; it must not define tabs semantics independently from Tabs root.
    dependsOn:
      prototypes:
        - P-BASE-TABS
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-CLAIM-ROLE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 必须 claim `base-tabs` anatomy family 的 `indicator` role。
      en: Tabs Indicator must claim the `indicator` role in the `base-tabs` anatomy family.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0004
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-SAME-DOMAIN
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 必须解析到同一 Tabs domain 中的 Tabs root；跨 Tabs domain 的 context 不得被消费。
      en: Tabs Indicator must resolve to the Tabs root in the same Tabs domain; context from another Tabs domain must not be consumed.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-ANATOMY-0005
        - C-CONTEXT-0002
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-CONTEXT-CONSUME
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 必须通过 Tabs context 读取或订阅 selected value、activeValue、orientation 与 activationMode。
      en: Tabs Indicator must read or subscribe to selected value, activeValue, orientation, and activationMode through Tabs context.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CONTEXT-0006
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-DERIVED-VALUE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 可以 expose 或提供派生的 selected `value` display state，但该 state 必须来源于 Tabs context，且不得成为 selected value 的 source of truth。
      en: Tabs Indicator may expose or provide derived selected `value` display state, but that state must come from Tabs context and must not become the source of truth for selected value.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
        - C-STATE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-DERIVED-ACTIVE-VALUE
    text:
      zh-CN: Tabs Indicator 可以 expose 或提供派生的 `activeValue` display state，用于表达 roving-focus active item 或最近活跃 trigger。
      en: Tabs Indicator may expose or provide derived `activeValue` display state to represent the roving-focus active item or most recently active trigger.
    dependsOn:
      contracts:
        - C-CONTEXT-0007
        - C-STATE-0001
  - id: P-BASE-TABS-INDICATOR-DERIVED-ORIENTATION
    text:

id: P-BASE-SELECT
type: prototype
title: Base Select is a root-owned select-only single-selection protocol
status: draft
since: 0.2.0-rc.0
summary: Base Select is a compound select-only protocol whose Root owns open state, committed value, selected text, collection order, request arbitration, and shared selection facts.
statement:
  zh-CN: >-
    Base Select 是由 Trigger 打开的 compound select-only single-selection protocol。Root 持有 open、committed value、selected text、controlled ownership、disabled、collection order 与 request arbitration；Trigger、Value、Content 和 Item 只通过同域 Root request entry 与 fact-oriented Context 协作。popup 中的临时导航不得改写 committed value，只有 Item commit 或 owner input 可以改变 selection。


  en: >-
    Base Select is a compound select-only single-selection protocol opened by a Trigger. Root owns open state, committed value, selected text, controlled ownership, disabled state, collection order, and request arbitration while Trigger, Value, Content, and Item cooperate through same-domain Root request entries and fact-oriented Context. Transient popup navigation must not rewrite the committed value; only Item commit or owner input may change selection.


anatomy:
  family: base-select
  roles:
    root: { cardinality: { min: 1, max: 1 } }
    trigger: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 1 } }
    value: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 1 } }
    content: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 1 } }
    surface: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 1 } }
    viewport: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 1 } }
    item-text: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 100 } }
    group: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 100 } }
    label: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 100 } }
    separator: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 100 } }
    item: { cardinality: { min: 0, max: 100 } }
  relations:
    - { kind: contains, parent: root, child: trigger }
    - { kind: contains, parent: root, child: value }
    - { kind: contains, parent: root, child: content }
    - { kind: contains, parent: content, child: item }
    - { kind: contains, parent: content, child: surface }
    - { kind: contains, parent: surface, child: viewport }
    - { kind: contains, parent: item, child: item-text }
    - { kind: contains, parent: content, child: group }
    - { kind: contains, parent: group, child: label }
    - { kind: contains, parent: content, child: separator }
criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-OPTIONAL-FIELD-COMPOSITION
    text:
      en: The explicit FieldSelectTrigger composition reuses the same setup and existing Field validator. Root observes optional Field disabled/readOnly policy and gates selection; the ordinary Trigger keeps content-derived naming while the Field entry uses Field label/description/error relations. Raw Root policy is kept separate from inherited Field policy to prevent feedback latching. This extends the earlier content-only Trigger surface without replacing selection, popup or focus protocols.
    dependsOn:
      contracts: [{ id: C-FIELD-SELECT-0001, since: 0.3.0-alpha.1 }]
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ROLE-SELECT-ONLY
    text:
      zh-CN: Select 必须表示从有限 option 集合中提交一个持久值的 select-only control，不得把 action menu、可自由输入 combobox 或 multi-select 伪装成当前协议。
      en: Select must represent a select-only control that commits one persistent value from a finite option set and must not disguise an action menu, free-form combobox, or multi-select as this protocol.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-select-root` 与 `asSelectRoot` 必须是同一 Root protocol 的 direct 与 authored-asHook entries。'
      en: '`base-select-root` and `asSelectRoot` must be direct and authored-asHook entries for the same Root protocol.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ROOT-OWNER
    text:
      zh-CN: Root 必须是 open、committed value、selected text、controlled ownership、disabled、collection、close-on-select policy 与 request arbitration 的 semantic owner。
      en: Root must be the semantic owner of open state, committed value, selected text, controlled ownership, disabled state, collection, close-on-select policy, and request arbitration.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-PROPS
    text:
      zh-CN: Root 必须接受 `open`、`defaultOpen`、`value`、`defaultValue`、`disabled` 与 `closeOnSelect`；分别提供 `open` 或 `value` 时对应事实进入受控模式。
      en: Root must accept `open`, `defaultOpen`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `disabled`, and `closeOnSelect`; providing `open` or `value` selects controlled ownership for the corresponding fact.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-REQUESTS
    text:
      zh-CN: Root 必须 expose open/value/textValue、open/close/toggle methods、同域 `requestOpen` 与 `requestValue` entries，以及 `openChange` 与 `valueChange` signals；受控请求不得越过 owner 改写最终事实。
      en: Root must expose open, value, and textValue, open, close, and toggle methods, same-domain `requestOpen` and `requestValue` entries, and `openChange` and `valueChange` signals; controlled requests must not bypass the owner to rewrite final facts.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-SELECTION-INVARIANT
    text:
      zh-CN: popup active option 与 committed selection 必须是不同事实；导航、pointer hover 与 Escape cancellation 不得改变 value，成功 commit 才能请求 value change。
      en: The popup active option and committed selection must remain distinct facts; navigation, pointer hover, and Escape cancellation must not change value, and only a successful commit may request a value change.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TEXT-DERIVATION
    text:
      zh-CN: textValue 必须由当前 committed value 对应 Item 的 collection text snapshot 派生；同一 Item 的 textValue 更新必须刷新 Root textValue 与 Value 回显而不改变 value。
      en: textValue must derive from the collection text snapshot of the Item matching the committed value; updating that Item's textValue must refresh Root textValue and Value display without changing value.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTEXT
    text:
      zh-CN: Root 必须通过同域 Context 发布 open/value ownership、disabled、selected text、popup active value、close policy 与最近 request facts；Context 不得充当版本化命令总线。
      en: Root must publish open and value ownership, disabled state, selected text, popup active value, close policy, and latest request facts through same-domain Context; Context must not act as a versioned command bus.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ANATOMY
    text:
      zh-CN: canonical Root、Trigger、Value、Content、Item 与可选结构 parts roles、cardinality 与 contains relations 必须由顶层 anatomy 字段定义并与运行时代码一致。
      en: Canonical Root, Trigger, Value, Content, Item and optional structural-part roles, cardinalities, and contains relations must be defined by the top-level anatomy field and match runtime code.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-DEFERRED-EXTENSIONS
    text:
      zh-CN: form submission、required validation、scroll controls、ItemIndicator、editable search、multi-select 与虚拟化不属于当前 Base 保证。
      en: Form submission, required validation, scroll controls, ItemIndicator, editable search, multi-select, and virtualization are outside the current Base guarantee.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-STRUCTURAL-SCOPE
    text:
      en: Surface, Viewport and ItemText follow P-BASE-SELECT-ALIGNMENT-PARTS. Group, Label and decorative Separator follow P-BASE-SELECT-STRUCTURAL-PARTS; SelectRoot installs only that naming-scope boundary, not an accessible group or naming relation. These optional parts do not replace Root ownership.

  - path: packages/prototypes/base/src/select/root.proto.ts
  - path: packages/prototypes/base/src/select/shared.ts

id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER
type: prototype
title: Base Select Trigger is an accessible select-only combobox command
status: draft
since: 0.2.0-rc.0
summary: Trigger projects the collapsed select control, reports popup relationships, and submits pointer and keyboard open requests to Root.
statement:
  zh-CN: Select Trigger 是同域 Root 中至多一个的 focusable command。它投射 select-only combobox role、expanded/controls/disabled facts 与可选 author name，并将 pointer、Enter、Space、ArrowDown、ArrowUp 的 open intent 提交到 Root；它不得拥有 open 或 selection。
  en: Select Trigger is the optional, at-most-one focusable command in the Root domain. It projects a select-only combobox role, expanded, controls, and disabled facts, and an optional author-provided name, and submits pointer, Enter, Space, ArrowDown, and ArrowUp open intent to Root; it must not own open state or selection.
criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-AUTHOR-NAME
    text:
      en: Optional accessibleLabel is a stable author-provided name projected through the public accessibility owner and updated reactively. Empty or absent values do not invent a name. Combobox naming cannot be derived from its selected content alone; callers must supply this label or an authoritative Field labelledBy relation. A resolved labelledBy takes precedence according to the accessible name computation. Selected Value content remains independent and is not concatenated into the label or duplicated as hidden label text. Existing Root selection, disabled, keyboard, focus and popup ownership are unchanged.
      zh-CN: 可选 accessibleLabel 由公共无障碍 owner 投射稳定 author name 并响应更新；空值不编造名称。combobox 不能只靠当前选中内容命名，调用方需传入该属性或权威 Field labelledBy；后者按命名标准优先。Value 内容独立，不拼入 label 或重复隐藏标签。Root 选值、禁用、键盘、焦点及弹层归属不变。
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-OPTIONAL-FIELD-COMPOSITION
    text:
      en: The explicit FieldSelectTrigger composition reuses the same setup and existing Field validator. Root observes optional Field disabled/readOnly policy and gates selection; the ordinary Trigger accepts an explicit accessibleLabel author name while the Field entry uses Field label/description/error relations. Raw Root policy is kept separate from inherited Field policy to prevent feedback latching. This extends the earlier Trigger surface without replacing selection, popup or focus protocols.
    dependsOn:
      contracts: [{ id: C-FIELD-SELECT-0001, since: 0.3.0-alpha.1 }]
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-TRANSIENT-CLEANUP
    text:
      zh-CN: 'press.cancel、pointer.cancel 与 view unmount 必须清除本 part 的 hovered/pressed；清理不得改变 canonical Root open/value or committed selected 或发出 activation/request。逻辑实例 remount 不得重放旧瞬态；pointer.leave 的语义清理不等于取消 Host 持有的 contact。'
      en: "press.cancel, pointer.cancel and view unmount must clear this part's hovered/pressed without changing canonical Root open/value or committed selected or emitting activation/requests. Logical-instance remount must not replay stale transient state; semantic pointer.leave cleanup does not cancel a Host-owned contact."
    dependsOn:
      contracts: [C-EVENT-TYPE-0002, C-LIFECYCLE-0008]
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-COLD-TAB
    text:
      zh-CN: 已提交 open=true 且 Trigger 持焦时，Trigger 自己对 Tab 发出一次关闭请求，不阻止默认动作，也不依赖 Content 已 mounted；受控拒绝维持逻辑 open。各 Item 只接收自身持焦的局部 Tab，避免同一次冒泡事件重复请求。
      en: When committed open is true and Trigger owns focus, Trigger itself submits one Tab close request without preventing default or depending on mounted Content. Controlled refusal preserves logical open. Each Item handles only its own focused local Tab to avoid duplicate requests for the same bubbling event.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-select-trigger` 与 `asSelectTrigger` 必须是同一 Trigger protocol 的 authoring entries。'
      en: '`base-select-trigger` and `asSelectTrigger` must be authoring entries for the same Trigger protocol.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-COMMAND
    text:
      zh-CN: Trigger 必须直接消费通用 Trigger 与 Focus 能力，发布 disabled/hovered/focused/focusVisible/pressed state，不得依赖 Base Button 获得自身语义。
      en: Trigger must directly consume generic Trigger and Focus capabilities, publish disabled, hovered, focused, focusVisible, and pressed state, and must not depend on Base Button for its semantics.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-A11Y
    text:
      zh-CN: Trigger 必须投射 combobox role、author-provided name、expanded、listbox popup、disabled 与指向稳定 Content identity 的 controls relation。
      en: Trigger must project a combobox role, author-provided name, expanded state, listbox popup, disabled state, and a controls relation targeting stable Content identity.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-REQUEST
    text:
      zh-CN: pointer activation 必须 toggle；Enter/Space 必须打开；ArrowDown/ArrowUp 必须阻止宿主默认滚动并以 selected-or-first/selected-or-last entry 请求打开，且每次物理交互只提交一次 request。
      en: Pointer activation must toggle, Enter and Space must open, and ArrowDown and ArrowUp must prevent host scrolling and request selected-or-first or selected-or-last entry, with one request per physical interaction.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-DISABLED
    text:
      zh-CN: Trigger local disabled 或 Root disabled 必须同时抑制 focus participation、pointer commit 与 keyboard open request。
      en: Local Trigger disabled or Root disabled must suppress focus participation, pointer commit, and keyboard open requests together.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-NO-SELECTION
    text:
      zh-CN: Trigger 不得因 open 或 navigation 改写 committed value；Value part 负责可见值回显，Root 负责 selection ownership。
      en: Trigger must not rewrite committed value because of open or navigation; Value owns visible value display and Root owns selection.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-TRIGGER-VIEW-LIFETIME
    text:
      en: A Trigger logical instance that survives view withdrawal must clear hovered and pressed state on unmount. Remount must not replay a prior pointer interaction or its downstream material deformation.

id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE
type: prototype
title: Base Select Value is a render-consumed committed-value display
status: draft
since: 0.2.0-rc.0
summary: Value is a non-interactive display part that renders Root-owned selected text or an author placeholder and establishes the value-class anatomy precedent.
statement:
  zh-CN: Select Value 是 Select family 中至多一个的 value-class display part。它从同域 Context 派生 displayValue：优先显示 Root-owned selected text，其次显示 committed raw value，未选择时显示 placeholder。Value 可以触发自身 renderer refresh，但不得成为 selection owner、event target、focus target 或独立 accessible control。
  en: Select Value is the optional, at-most-one value-class display part in the Select family. It derives displayValue from same-domain Context, preferring Root-owned selected text, then the committed raw value, and showing placeholder when unselected. Value may request its own renderer refresh but must not become a selection owner, event target, focus target, or independent accessible control.
criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-ROLE
    text:
      zh-CN: Value 只能作为 committed Select value 的可见回显，不得表示 popup active option、可编辑 input 或自治 value control。
      en: Value may only visibly reflect the committed Select value and must not represent the popup active option, an editable input, or an autonomous value control.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-select-value` 与 `asSelectValue` 必须是同一 Value protocol 的 authoring entries。'
      en: '`base-select-value` and `asSelectValue` must be authoring entries for the same Value protocol.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-CONTEXT
    text:
      zh-CN: Value 必须从同域 Select Context 订阅 committed value 与 textValue，不得复制 Root props、读取 host DOM 或消费 popup activeValue 作为显示真相。
      en: Value must subscribe to committed value and textValue from same-domain Select Context and must not copy Root props, read host DOM, or consume popup activeValue as display truth.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-FALLBACK
    text:
      zh-CN: displayValue 必须按 textValue、raw value、placeholder、空内容的顺序回退；placeholder prop 更新必须立即刷新尚未选择的 Value。
      en: displayValue must fall back in textValue, raw value, placeholder, then empty-content order; updating placeholder must immediately refresh an unselected Value.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-RENDER-REFRESH
    text:
      zh-CN: displayValue 变化必须通过 prototype-owned `run.update()` 刷新 renderer-consumed children；宿主 App 不应被要求重复渲染同一 selected text。
      en: A displayValue change must refresh renderer-consumed children through prototype-owned `run.update()`; the host App must not be required to render the same selected text again.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-DERIVED-EXPOSE
    text:
      zh-CN: Value 必须 expose 只读语义上的 displayValue state，供 styled prototype 与验证读取；该 state 不得反向写入 Root value。
      en: Value must expose a semantically read-only displayValue state for styled prototypes and verification; that state must not write back to Root value.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-NO-INTERACTION
    text:
      zh-CN: Value 不得安装 Trigger、Focusable、activation route 或 outward event，也不得成为独立 accessible control；它必须对 pointer hit testing 透明，确保嵌套于 Trigger 时由 Trigger 接收完整表面的指针激活。
      en: Value must not install Trigger, Focusable, activation routes, or outward events, and must not become an independent accessible control; it must be transparent to pointer hit testing so a containing Trigger receives pointer activation across its complete surface.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-VALUE-CLASS-PRECEDENT
    text:
      zh-CN: Value-class part 的核心边界是“消费 owner fact 并拥有回显刷新”，而不是“拥有 input value”；未来 Input 等组件若兼具输入所有权，必须另行编目该差异。
      en: The core boundary of a value-class part is consuming owner facts and owning display refresh, not owning an input value; future components such as Input that also own input must catalog that distinction separately.
sources:
  - path: packages/prototypes/base/src/select/value.proto.ts
  - path: packages/prototypes/base/src/select/types.ts
  - path: https://www.radix-ui.com/primitives/docs/components/select#value
    label: Radix Select Value

  prototypes: [P-BASE-SELECT]
  contracts: [C-CONTEXT-0001, C-STATE-0001, C-EXPOSE-STATE-0001, C-CORE-SYNTAX-0003]
verifies: { tests: [T-BASE-SELECT-VALUE-0001] }
revisions:
  - version: 0.2.0-rc.0
    change: introduced
    summary: Introduced the first value-class part contract with context-derived display, fallback, render refresh, and non-interactive boundaries.
tags: [prototype, base, select, value, value-class, render, context]
files.spec/prototypes/P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT.ya:
id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT
type: prototype
title: Base Select Content is a transitional positioned listbox surface
status: draft
since: 0.2.0-rc.0
summary: Content binds Root visibility to Overlay and Transition, owns listbox focus navigation and dismissal, and portals an anchored option surface.
statement:
  zh-CN: Select Content 是 Root 同域中至多一个的 vertical listbox surface。它从 Root open 派生 Overlay/Transition presence，使用 Trigger PartView 作为 anchor，并建立 selected-or-boundary focus entry、asFocusRoving keyboard navigation、typeahead 与 Escape/Tab/outside dismissal。popup active option 与 committed selection 必须保持分离，普通 dismissal 都回到 Root request entry；具名结构错误可独立终止 presentation，但不改变 Root 事实。
  en: Select Content is the optional, at-most-one vertical listbox surface in the Root domain. It derives Overlay and Transition presence from Root open, uses the Trigger PartView as its anchor, and establishes selected-or-boundary focus entry, asFocusRoving keyboard navigation, typeahead, and Escape, Tab, and outside dismissal. Popup active option and committed selection must remain separate, and every ordinary dismissal returns to the Root request entry; a named structural failure may separately abort presentation without changing Root facts.
criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: "'`base-select-content` 与 `asSelectContent` 必须是同一 Content protocol 的 authoring entries，并向下游提供 Transition handle。'"
      en: "'`base-select-content` and `asSelectContent` must be authoring entries for the same Content protocol and provide the Transition handle downstream.'"
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-A11Y
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Content 必须投射 listbox role、vertical orientation 与稳定 identity；open entry 必须等本轮同步挂载的 Item collection 稳定后，把 DOM focus 移到 selected enabled Item，缺失时才按 request boundary 进入 enabled Item；不得因 adapter 逐项挂载而过早聚焦首项。'
      en: 'Content must project a listbox role, vertical orientation, and stable identity; open entry must wait until the synchronously mounted Item collection for the current turn is stable, then move DOM focus to the selected enabled Item or, only when absent, to an enabled Item at the requested boundary; adapter-by-adapter item mounting must not cause an early first-item fallback.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-FOCUS-ROVING
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Content 必须以 `asFocusRoving` 作为 ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End、orientation、boundary 与 deferred entry 的唯一 owner；不得消费 `useFocusRoving` 或让 Item 手动转发 sibling movement。'
      en: 'Content must use `asFocusRoving` as the sole owner of ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, orientation, boundaries, and deferred entry; it must not consume `useFocusRoving` or make Items manually forward sibling movement.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-OVERLAY-PRESENCE
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Content 必须消费 non-modal Overlay，并以 `asTransition` 作为唯一 Presence driver；普通 dismissal 只有 Root 已提交 open=false 才能驱动 leave，随后按配置保留 leave view，只在 closed 后 detach。受控 owner 拒绝 close 请求时，不得暂时 entering/leaving、撤销准备或重置 focus/scroll。'
      en: 'Content must consume a non-modal Overlay and bind `asTransition` as its sole Presence driver; ordinary dismissal drives leave only for Root committed open=false; it then retains the configured leaving view and detaches only after reaching closed. A controlled owner refusing a close request must not transiently enter/leave, cancel preparation, or reset focus/scroll.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-POSITION
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Content 必须接受 side、align、sideOffset、alignOffset、avoidCollisions 与 collisionPadding，把运行时更新提交给 fixed、portal、Trigger-anchored positioning policy。'
      en: 'Content must accept side, align, sideOffset, alignOffset, avoidCollisions, and collisionPadding and submit runtime updates to a fixed, portaled, Trigger-anchored positioning policy.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-KEYBOARD
    text:
      zh-CN: 'open Content 必须支持 ArrowDown/ArrowUp、Home/End、Enter/Space commit 与 printable-character typeahead；typeahead expiry 必须消费 runtime delay policy，disabled Item 必须从 focus navigation 与 commit 中排除。'
      en: 'Open Content must support ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End, Enter and Space commit, and printable-character typeahead; typeahead expiry must consume the runtime delay policy, and disabled Items must be excluded from focus navigation and commit.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-DISMISS
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Escape 必须 close 且不改变 selection，并把焦点返回 Trigger；Tab 必须 close 而不阻止宿主遍历，包括 deferred entry 尚未完成且焦点仍在同域唯一 Trigger 的阶段；outside press 必须 close；Trigger activation 必须被 inside Boundary 识别以避免一次 pointer activation 产生二次 toggle。'
      en: 'Escape must close without changing selection and return focus to Trigger, Tab must close without preventing host traversal, including deferred entry while the unique same-domain Trigger still owns focus, outside press must close, and Trigger activation must be classified inside the Boundary to avoid a double toggle from one pointer activation.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-INITIAL-ALIGNMENT-INTENT
    text:
      en: "'The internal S1 resolver accepts explicit mode, committed value with an unset distinction, ordered semantic records with associated row/text PartView identities, reference identities and an initial-collection settlement phase. Explicit popper preserves edge config. In a settled ordinary initial collection, a unique enabled match wins; unset or unmatched value uses the first enabled record. Duplicate values, disabled selected compatibility, missing associated targets, empty/all-disabled collections, unsettled collections and already-open updates remain named unresolved results, not automatic popper policy. No focus candidate, speculative controlled request, geometry or host query selects targets. Neutral constraints are immutable and explicit. The pure initial resolver alone does not establish runtime alignment; the Content presentation-admission and current-request criteria govern consumer wiring.'"
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-PRESENTATION-ADMISSION
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Content 是唯一 presence owner；Root open/selection 事实与组合 admission 分离。仅在本次同步组合已经提交后分类。legacy（零 Surface/Viewport/ItemText）及 explicit popper 清除旧 target binding/Surface Boundary 替换，使用原 edge policy 并释放当前冷 gate；不得在未 settled 时先显示 edge 再跳 aligned。full-pending 保留可测 view，隐藏且不启动默认 delay 焦点任务，等待当前定位请求。valid 仅由当前 request 的 applied 进入，释放本次 gate 后复核最新 Root open/value 与 request 才可请求入场焦点。已成功入场后，较新的 Item 或外部 Focus owner 保持归属。具名 presentation abort 必须撤销该资格和 scope，之后修复不得复用旧资格。首次入场、实际 value 变化和新的关闭重开周期仍保留原焦点准入。structure-invalid 是具名 presentation abort，不伪造 Root close/openChange 或改变 selection；Content 撤销定位 binding、旧 release、entry task、geometry observers 与 focus scope并终结为 closed，仅保留结构恢复订阅。无关 Context/value 更新不得重启；合法结构重新提交或显式 mode 转 popper 才可重新 admission。unsupported-selection 必须与结构错误分开，仅合法已注册选值或显式 mode 变更恢复。geometry-unavailable 另以 select.geometry 原因诊断并终结 presentation，不冒充作者结构错误；仅新一次真实关闭后重开、结构修复或显式 popper 重试；不得因本次 popper 尺寸支持全局放开其他 geometry failure，无关 Context 不循环。冷准备期间 Content 尚未 mounted 时不能承担 Trigger 输入；Trigger 自己处理持焦 Tab，各 Item 仅在自己的 portable 根事件处理自身持焦 Tab（不是 Content global 当前焦点再判），均不阻止原生 Tab 默认动作且同事件只发一个关闭请求。Trigger/Item 通过既有 requestSelectOpen 在请求前调用同域唯一当前 Content 的内部 __cancelPendingEntry；该命令只撤销当前 open epoch 的 delay/applied 自动焦点，不改 presence、Root 或几何 gate，迟到 item/measure 不复活焦点。只有 committed false→true 后重新允许入场；缺失/歧义 Content 不随意选第一个。撤回 view 时以同域当前 Item 的实际 focused 事实确认归属（不得套用过滤 disabled 的导航候选表），仅在其已知 option 仍持有焦点时还焦 Trigger，不夺取外部焦点。'
      en: 'Content is the sole presence owner; Root open/selection facts are separate from composition admission. Classify only after the current synchronous composition commits. Legacy (no Surface/Viewport/ItemText) and explicit popper clear old target binding and Surface Boundary replacement, use the existing edge policy, and release the current cold gate; an unsettled composition must not first reveal edge and then jump to aligned.  Full-pending retains a measurable view, stays hidden, and starts no default delayed focus task while awaiting the current positioning request. Valid follows only applied from the current request; after gate release, recheck current Root open/value and request before requesting entry focus. After accepted entry, a newer Item or external Focus owner keeps ownership. A named presentation abort must retire that exemption and the scope, so a later repair cannot reuse the old exemption. Initial entry, a genuine value replacement and a fresh close/reopen cycle retain existing focus admission. Structure-invalid is a named presentation abort without a Root close/openChange or selection mutation; Content cancels binding, old releases, entry tasks, geometry observers, and focus scope, reaching closed while retaining structural recovery subscriptions. Unrelated Context/value updates cannot restart it; a newly committed valid structure or explicit mode change to popper may readmit. Unsupported-selection is distinct from structural errors and recovers only for a valid represented selection or explicit mode change. Geometry-unavailable terminates presentation with a distinct select.geometry diagnostic rather than an author-structure error; retry requires an actual closed/reopen cycle, structural repair, or explicit popper, not unrelated Context updates. A cold Content that has not mounted cannot own Trigger input: Trigger handles Tab while it owns focus, while each Item handles its own focused Tab through its portable root event rather than Content global current-focus reclassification. Neither prevents native Tab default behavior, and the same event submits only one close request. Before requesting, Trigger/Item use existing requestSelectOpen to call internal __cancelPendingEntry on the unique current same-domain Content. It revokes delayed/applied automatic focus for this open epoch without changing presence, Root, or the geometry gate; late items/measurement cannot revive focus. Only a committed false→true cycle permits entry again. Missing/ambiguous Content never selects an arbitrary first part. Withdrawal determines ownership from current same-domain Item focused facts, without filtering out disabled navigation candidates, and restores Trigger focus only when a known option still owns focus, never stealing external focus.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-CURRENT-ALIGNMENT-INTENT
    text:
      zh-CN: 'Base position 默认 popper；下游可明确声明 item-aligned 默认。完整组合首次结算使用既有 initial intent；已打开后的 committed value 替换只准入唯一 enabled、已注册且具有实际唯一 ItemText 的匹配项，不将首次注册的 first-enabled fallback 泛化为运行期 fallback。同值 Context 重复不得重置 viewport scroll 或重新居中；Root 将有序 collection 的 value/textValue/disabled 标量快照去重后才增加内部 collectionRevision，并在任何通知前保存快照与版本；重复通知不增版本。新值、记录版本、part 退役/替换、mode 变更与关闭必须先失效旧 request。popup 的 inline 起点与 Trigger 的 inline 起点对齐，并按 Trigger 的 inline 尺寸保持最小 span；定位不读取 Trigger 文本或行内文本度量。key 与交付复核均比较版本；版本不是 identity/readiness，也不能解锁 structure-invalid 或重置 initial 状态。合法记录修复允许重试 unsupported-selection/geometry-unavailable。成功 initial fallback 后，仅 Root committed value 和结构版本连续未变（首次偏离或退出 item-aligned 永久作废该记录）的 metadata-only 更新可验证并保留当时唯一 enabled candidate.value；不得重新挑 first-enabled，不比较 PartView/expose wrapper 身份，原候选 disabled/换值/消失或结构变更仍走 current resolver 的具名边界。撤回 beforeLeave 时若当前 Root 已换值，保留 view 仍须更新 current target；旧 release/focus 不得覆盖。'
      en: 'Base position defaults to popper; a downstream prototype may explicitly default to item-aligned. A full composition initially uses the existing initial intent; an already-open committed value replacement admits only a unique enabled registered match with one actual ItemText, without generalizing the first-registration first-enabled fallback into runtime fallback. Repeated same-value Context must not reset viewport scroll or recenter. Root increments internal collectionRevision only after deduplicating the ordered value/textValue/disabled scalar snapshot, saving snapshot and version before any notification. Repeated notifications do not increment it. A new value or record revision, retired/replaced part, mode change, or close invalidates the old request first. The popup inline start aligns with the Trigger inline start and keeps the Trigger inline span as its minimum; placement never reads Trigger text or row text metrics. Both request keys and delivery checks compare revision; it is not identity/readiness and cannot unlock structure-invalid or reset initial state. Valid record repair may retry unsupported-selection/geometry-unavailable. After successful initial fallback, a metadata-only update may validate and retain that same unique enabled candidate.value only while Root committed value and structure version remain continuously unchanged (the first deviation or exit from item-aligned permanently invalidates that record). It must not choose a new first-enabled candidate or compare PartView/expose wrapper identity; candidate disability, changed/missing value, or structural changes remain subject to the named current-resolver boundary. When beforeLeave is withdrawn after Root value changes, the retained view must still update its current target; stale release/focus cannot override it.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-CONTENT-DEFERRED-SURFACES
    text:
      zh-CN: 'item-aligned 仅保证已准入的完整实际 parts 组合及选值范围；零 Surface legacy 不计作默认对齐完成。Scroll buttons、虚拟化及未准入的 disabled/unknown 更新兼容仍不在保证内。'
      en: 'Item alignment is bounded to the admitted complete real-parts composition and selection subset; zero-Surface legacy does not count as completed default alignment. Scroll buttons, virtualization, and unadmitted disabled/unknown update compatibility remain outside the guarantee.'

id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM
type: prototype
title: Base Select Item is a selectable collection option
status: draft
since: 0.2.0-rc.0
summary: Item publishes ordered option metadata, separates transient active state from committed selected state, and submits enabled commits to Root.
statement:
  zh-CN: Select Item 是 Content 中可重复出现的 option。它发布 value/textValue/disabled collection snapshot、option semantics、committed selected 与 transient active state。focus 或 enabled pointer intent 可以改变 popup active option；Enter、Space 或 pointer activation 发出 select 并请求 Root commit。disabled Item 必须同时退出 focus navigation 与 commit。
  en: Select Item is a repeatable option within Content. It publishes value, textValue, and disabled collection snapshots, option semantics, committed selected state, and transient active state. Focus or enabled pointer intent may change the popup active option, while Enter, Space, or pointer activation emits select and requests a Root commit. A disabled Item must leave both focus navigation and commit.
criteria:
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-MOUSE-FOCUS-HANDOFF
    text:
      zh-CN: 在已打开且 Root/Item 均 enabled 的 popup 中，仅真实 pointer.move 的已知 mouse 且已知无按键样本可请求当前 Item 的共享 Focus owner，支持时保留滚动位置；不得只因 pointer.enter、touch、pen、unknown 或持键移动而接管导航。Item 不得在请求被接受和宿主焦点观察前预先把另一个 option 发布为 active，且不得在此回调独立写 focused/focusVisible 或改变 committed selected/value/open。共享焦点交接稳定后，同一域只保留一个 active option；新的键盘导航继续通过同一 Focus owner 仲裁。相同已 focused Item 的合法新输入意图仍交给 Focus，不能以局部 early-return 丢弃 modality 观察。既有非 focused pointerleave 清理不变，focused Item 不因离开就自动恢复 selected option。
      en: In an open popup with both Root and Item enabled, only a real pointer.move sample known to be mouse input with no buttons may request the current Item's shared Focus owner, preserving scroll where supported. Pointer enter alone, touch, pen, unknown facts and button-held movement must not take over navigation. Item must not prepublish another option as active before request admission and host focus observation, independently write focused or focusVisible in this callback, or change committed selected, value or open. After the shared focus transition settles, the domain retains only one active option, and later keyboard navigation arbitrates through the same Focus owner. A legitimate new input intent on an already focused Item still reaches Focus; a local early return must not discard modality observation. Existing non-focused pointerleave cleanup remains unchanged; leaving a focused Item does not automatically restore the selected option.
    dependsOn:
      contracts: [C-EVENT-0002, C-EVENT-TYPE-0003, C-AS-FOCUSABLE-0001, C-FOCUS-0001]
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-TRANSIENT-CLEANUP
    text:
      zh-CN: 'press.cancel、pointer.cancel 与 view unmount 必须清除本 part 的 hovered/pressed；清理不得改变 canonical Root open/value or committed selected 或发出 activation/request。逻辑实例 remount 不得重放旧瞬态；pointer.leave 的语义清理不等于取消 Host 持有的 contact。'
      en: "press.cancel, pointer.cancel and view unmount must clear this part's hovered/pressed without changing canonical Root open/value or committed selected or emitting activation/requests. Logical-instance remount must not replay stale transient state; semantic pointer.leave cleanup does not cancel a Host-owned contact."
    dependsOn:
      contracts: [C-EVENT-TYPE-0002, C-LIFECYCLE-0008]
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-LOCAL-TAB
    text:
      zh-CN: 已打开、enabled 且自身持焦的 Item 通过自己的 portable key.down 处理 Tab；先取消同域唯一 Content 的本次自动入场焦点，再请求关闭，不阻止默认动作。不得由 Content global 根据后来焦点重新判定原事件归属。
      en: An open enabled focused Item handles Tab through its own portable key.down. It first cancels this epoch automatic entry focus in the unique same-domain Content, then requests close without preventing default. Content global handlers must not reclassify the original event from later focus.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-AUTHORING-ENTRIES
    text:
      zh-CN: '`base-select-item` 与 `asSelectItem` 必须是同一 Item protocol 的 authoring entries。'
      en: '`base-select-item` and `asSelectItem` must be authoring entries for the same Item protocol.'
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-COLLECTION
    text:
      zh-CN: Item 必须通过 Collection Item 发布有序的 value、textValue、disabled 与 position snapshot；value 必须是 option identity。
      en: Item must publish an ordered value, textValue, disabled, and position snapshot through Collection Item, with value as the option identity.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-METADATA-FOCUS-ORDER
    text:
      zh-CN: 本地 disabled 变为 true 时，Item 必须在清除现持焦事实前发布当前 collection 元数据，让 Content 认领并安全退出已禁用的持焦项；恢复 enabled 时先恢复焦点资格再发布，以便当前合法目标恢复可聚焦。同步通知导致 owner dispose 后不得继续同步交互状态。
      en: When local disabled becomes true, Item publishes current collection metadata before clearing existing focus ownership so Content can safely retire a now-disabled focused item. Re-enabling restores focus eligibility before publication so the admitted current target can receive focus. Synchronous owner disposal during notification cancels further interaction synchronization.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-A11Y
    text:
      zh-CN: Item 必须投射 option role、content-derived name、selected、disabled 与 activate action。
      en: Item must project an option role, content-derived name, selected state, disabled state, and activate action.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-STATE-SEPARATION
    text:
      zh-CN: selected 必须严格派生自 committed Root value；active 必须表示 open popup 中的当前 focus/pointer option。pointer 离开非 focused Item 时必须清除该 Item 的 pointer active/highlight；popup close 时每个 Item 必须清除 hovered、pressed、focused 与 active transient facts。active 变化不得隐式改变 selected 或 value。
      en: selected must derive strictly from committed Root value, while active represents the current focus or pointer option in the open popup. Pointer leave from a non-focused Item must clear that Item's pointer active or highlight, and popup close must clear hovered, pressed, focused, and active transient facts from every Item. Changing active must not implicitly change selected or value.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-COMMIT
    text:
      zh-CN: enabled activation 必须发出包含 value 与 reason 的 `select` signal，向 Root `requestValue` 提交 value/textValue，并按 Item/Root close policy 请求 close。
      en: Enabled activation must emit a `select` signal containing value and reason, submit value and textValue to Root `requestValue`, and request close according to Item or Root close policy.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-CONTROLLED
    text:
      zh-CN: 受控 value request 后 Item selected 必须保持 owner value 对应状态，直到新的 value input 到达；open 可以按独立 ownership 关闭。
      en: After a controlled value request, Item selected state must continue matching the owner value until new value input arrives; open may close according to its independent ownership.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-ITEM-DISABLED
    text:
      zh-CN: Item local disabled 或 Root disabled 必须抑制 focus participation、active 更新、select signal、value request 与 close request，并投射 aria-disabled。
      en: Local Item disabled or Root disabled must suppress focus participation, active updates, select signal, value request, and close request, and project aria-disabled.

  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-STRUCTURAL-PARTS-OWNERSHIP
    text:
      en: Group and Label preserve slots. Group is a passive accessible group; Label supplies that group's name and is not a control label or activation target. Neither part installs selection, collection, focus, input, presence or positioning ownership. Root remains the sole selection and collection owner, including mixed grouped and ungrouped Items in their authored order.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-STRUCTURAL-PARTS-SCOPE
    text:
      en: Group and Label claim their optional SELECT_FAMILY roles. The separate static SELECT_GROUP_FAMILY is a naming-scope family, not a second Select collection. Each Group claims its root and each SelectRoot claims a scope-only root barrier without adding an accessible group role or naming relationship. Label claims its label role. The nearest naming-scope root isolates sibling and nested Groups, distinct Select roots and malformed Labels under nested Select roots. Existing Content-to-Item and Viewport-to-Item ancestor relations remain valid through Group wrappers.
  - id: P-BASE-SELECT-STRUCTURAL-PARTS-NAME
    text:
      en: Only Group declares labelledBy targeting the label role and exact label protocol key in its own naming scope; Label registers that part key. No generated label ID, host node, DOM query or adapter identity enters portable state or context. Missing or duplicate Labels fail closed; removal, reparent, rematerialization and disposal use the existing structured relationship lease lifecycle without stale cross-group names.

    text:
      en: Separator claims its optional SELECT_FAMILY role, declares a hidden accessibility tree contribution, renders no children and owns no events, focus or collection member.
